correctness.rationale: Conditional positive-composition law follows since every internal gap composition at span r has exactly N-r left-endpoint placements. From (1,...,1), the transition g→g+e_i with probability g_i/r yields target uniform composition because sum_i(h_i-1)=r+1-m. Conditional E[(g_i+1_i)/(r+1)|g]=g_i/r gives the simultaneous vector martingale; absolute gaps cannot decrease. Jensen plus independent-copy covariance identity establishes opposite signed associations and strict boundaries for k≥3 and N>k. Independent exact rational enumeration tested all k,N through N=9, conditional moments, transition distribution and covariance formulas; no finite-experiment leap is used.
